A Karnofsky performance score of less than 60 at screening disqualifies the participant. 4. Participants with a history of allergy or known hypersensitivity to any investigational medicinal products or related substances are excluded. 5. A body mass index (BMI) of less than 17 kg/m² is a disqualifying factor. 6. Participants with tuberculosis (TB) infection and historical drug susceptibility testing (DST) or minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) results indicating likely resistance to pretomanid, delamanid, linezolid, or bedaquiline must be reviewed with the Sponsor Medical Monitor for interpretation of results. 7. Participants who are expected to require a surgical procedure for their pulmonary disease are excluded. 8. Individuals who have participated in other clinical studies involving investigational agents within eight weeks prior to screening or are currently enrolled in a study involving medicinal agents are excluded. However, participants in observational studies or follow-up periods of trials without active drug therapy may be considered. 9. Participants with any of the following at screening are excluded: a. A corrected QT interval by Fredericia (QTcF) on ECG > 500 msec. Participants with QTcF > 450 msec must be discussed with and approved by the Sponsor Medical Monitor. b. Heart failure. c. A personal or family history of congenital QT prolongation. d. Untreated or ongoing hypothyroidism. e. A history of or ongoing bradyarrhythmia. f. A history of torsades de pointes. 10. Females with a positive pregnancy test at screening, those known to be pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to conceive during the study or within six months after treatment cessation are excluded. Similarly, males planning to conceive during the study or within six months after treatment cessation are excluded. 11. Participants with Grade 3 or 4 peripheral neuropathy, or those with Grade 1 or 2 neuropathy likely to worsen during the study, are excluded based on the investigator's opinion. 12. Prior use of monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) within two weeks of randomization disqualifies the participant. 13. Prior use of serotonergic antidepressants within three days of randomization is excluded if the investigator foresees potential risks for serotonin syndrome when combined with linezolid. 14. Participants who have received more than two weeks of bedaquiline, linezolid, or delamanid prior to the first dose of the investigational medicinal product (IMP) are excluded. 15. Participants with newly diagnosed TB and HIV who require initiation of HIV therapy before completing at least two weeks of an antituberculosis regimen are excluded. 16. HIV-infected participants planning to continue using zidovudine, stavudine, or didanosine are excluded. The use of the antiretroviral therapy (ART) booster cobicistat is also not permitted. 17. Participants with any of the following toxicities at screening are excluded: a. Viral load > 1,000 copies/mL (unless newly diagnosed HIV and not yet on ART). b. CD4+ count < 100 cells/μL (for HIV-positive participants). c. Serum potassium below the laboratory's lower limit of normal. d. Hemoglobin < 9.0 g/dL or < 90 g/L. e. Platelet count < 100,000/mm³ or < 100 × 10⁹/L. f. White blood cell count < 2.5 × 10⁹/L. g. ALT, AST, or bilirubin > 3 times the upper limit of normal (ULN). h. Direct bilirubin greater than the ULN. i. Albumin < 3.0 g/dL or < 30 g/L. 18. Participants with known resistance to bedaquiline, pretomanid, linezolid, or delamanid are excluded. 19. Participants with any condition (social or medical) that, in the investigator's opinion, would make study participation unsafe are excluded. 20. Prior use of bedaquiline, pretomanid, linezolid, or delamanid for one or more months disqualifies the participant. 21. Patients not eligible to start a new course of multidrug-resistant TB (MDR-TB) or extensively drug-resistant TB (XDR-TB) treatment according to local protocol are excluded. Reasons may include: a. Currently on MDR-TB treatment for at least two weeks without failure. b. No permanent physical address. c. History of loss to follow-up in previous treatment without changes in circumstances or motivation. 22. Participants with tuberculous meningoencephalitis, brain abscesses, osteomyelitis, or arthritis are excluded. 23. Alanine transaminase (ALT), aspartate transaminase (AST), or bilirubin levels greater than three times the ULN disqualify the participant. 24. Participants taking medications contraindicated with the trial drugs are excluded. 25. QTcF > 450 msec or other uncorrected risk factors for torsades de pointes disqualify the participant. 26. Participants with a history of cardiac disease, syncopal episodes, or significant arrhythmias (excluding sinus arrhythmia) are excluded. 27. Any baseline laboratory value consistent with Grade 4 toxicity disqualifies the participant. 28. Moribund participants are excluded. 29. Participants with no microbiological confirmation of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in sputum or no resistance to rifampicin are excluded. 30. Participants must be aged 15 years or older (where locally approved) and provide informed consent to participate.
